platform_tenant.purpose: This page lists every institution (tenant) registered on FLIXARE with its status, identity, subscription, and access settings, so the platform team can monitor and control each school's access.

features.summary: See the tenant count summary (total, active, needs action) at the top of the page.
features.filter: Filter the list by status: All, Active, Trial, or Rejected/Suspended.
features.search: Search tenants by name or tenant code.
features.detail: View tenant details: institution identity, PIC contact, subscription (plan, seats, billing cycle), and access & domain.
features.access: Suspend a tenant or reactivate it.

steps.s1: Pick a status tab or type a tenant name/code in the search box to find an institution.
steps.s2: Click a tenant name in the left list to open its details in the right panel.
steps.s3: Review the tenant's identity, PIC contact, and subscription data.
steps.s4: To stop access, click "Suspend..." and confirm. To restore it, click "Activate..." and confirm.

tips.suspend: A suspended tenant blocks access for all of that school's users until it is reactivated.
tips.subdomain: The subdomain is locked once the tenant is active and cannot be changed from this page.

school_admin_students.purpose: This page manages the school's student data: identity, class, linked parents, and student login accounts. Active students count against the school's subscription seats.

features.add: Add students one by one or import many at once from an Excel/CSV file (parent data can be imported too).
features.find: Search students by name, NIS, or NISN, and filter by class or students without parents.
features.edit: Edit student data, move classes, link parents, and deactivate or delete students.
features.invite: Invite students to get an account: students with email receive an email invitation, students without email get a username and activation code.
features.seats: Monitor subscription seat usage and add seats when full.

steps.s1: Make sure classes exist first; the "Add student" button is enabled only when there is at least one class.
steps.s2: Click "Add student" to enter one by one, or "Import Excel/CSV", download the template, fill it in, and upload the file.
steps.s3: Complete the fields marked * and click "Save".
steps.s4: Open a student record to link parents if none are linked yet.
steps.s5: Click the invite button to send account invitations to students not yet invited.
steps.s6: If activation codes appear, copy and share them with students; codes are shown only once.

tips.seat_full: When seats are full, new students are rejected until seats are added from the subscription page.
tips.delete: A student can only be deleted if they have no attendance, grades, or report cards. Otherwise, deactivate them.
tips.inactive: Inactive students do not count as seats and cannot sign in.
tips.code_expiry: Activation codes are valid for 72 hours.

teacher_grades.purpose: This page lists all classes and subjects you teach in the active semester, with the progress of final report-card grades. Locked grades are used by homeroom teachers to compile report cards.

features.overview: See your teaching assignments (class × subject) for the active semester.
features.progress: Track each grade sheet's progress: Not started, Partial, Ready to lock, or Locked.
features.fill: Open a grade sheet to enter each student's final score and achievement description.
features.lock: Lock grades once all students are complete so they can be used for report cards.

steps.s1: Pick a class and subject from the list, then click "Enter grades".
steps.s2: Enter a final score of 0–100 (decimals allowed) and an achievement description for each student.
steps.s3: Save your changes; grades can be saved partially and continued later.
steps.s4: Once all students are complete, lock the grades.
steps.s5: Return to the list to confirm the grade sheet status is "Locked".

tips.semester: Grades can be entered only after the school admin activates the academic year and semester.
tips.locked: Locked grades cannot be changed unless the principal unlocks them.
tips.assignment: If the list is empty, you have no teaching assignment this semester. Contact the school admin.

student_tasks.purpose: This page shows all tasks and projects from your teachers, with deadlines, submission status, scores, and correction notes.

features.summary: See a summary of tasks: total, to do, awaiting score, and graded.
features.filter: Filter tasks by subject and status.
features.search: Search tasks by title, instructions, subject, or teacher name.
features.detail: Open a task to read its instructions and submit your answer.
features.feedback: See scores and correction notes from teachers for graded tasks.

steps.s1: Use the subject filter or the "To Do" status to see unfinished tasks.
steps.s2: Click a task card to open its details and read the instructions.
steps.s3: Attach your answer file and add a note if needed.
steps.s4: Submit the task before the deadline; its status changes to "Submitted".
steps.s5: Check the "Graded" tab later to see your score and teacher notes.

tips.deadline: Watch the deadline on each task card so you don't submit late.

platform_audit_log.purpose: This page shows a record of every change in the platform console (applications, tenants, invoices, payments, clusters, plans, authentication, master data, and navigation) so the platform team can trace who did what and when. Records cannot be edited or deleted.

features.filter: Filter records by keyword, actor, date range, module, severity, or failed only.
features.detail: View record details: before/after changes, note, WIB time, IP address, device, and request ID.
features.chain: Check the hash chain status that proves records were not altered.
features.export: Export the filtered records to CSV.

steps.s1: Set filters in the top card; the list updates immediately and the filters are kept in the page address.
steps.s2: Click a record row to open its details in the right panel.
steps.s3: Click "Load 10 more" to see older records.
steps.s4: Click "This actor's activity" to see the same actor's activity over the last 30 days.
steps.s5: Click "Export CSV" to download the filtered records.

tips.retention: Records are kept for 2 years, then removed automatically by the retention job.
tips.export: Exports are recorded in the audit log too.

platform_clusters.purpose: This page lets the platform infrastructure team manage the PostgreSQL clusters where each tenant database is created: connection, capacity, placement status, and backup policy.

features.cards: Monitor each cluster’s capacity (databases used out of the maximum) on the cards at the top.
features.test: Run a real connection test and see the PostgreSQL version, latency, and SSL usage.
features.capacity: Set the maximum tenant databases, connection pool per database, and capacity warning threshold.
features.status: Set the placement status: "Accepting tenants", "Draining", or "Maintenance".
features.backup: Set the snapshot schedule, retention, and point-in-time recovery, and see the last snapshot.
features.dbs: See the largest tenant databases on the selected cluster.

steps.s1: Click a cluster card to open its settings, or click "New cluster" to add one.
steps.s2: Fill in the host, port, admin user, password, and SSL mode, then click "Test connection".
steps.s3: Adjust capacity, backup, and placement status as needed.
steps.s4: Click "Save changes" (or "Add cluster") in the bottom bar; click "Discard" to revert the form.

tips.test: A new cluster can only be saved after a successful connection test; the server re-tests whenever the connection changes.
tips.maintenance: "Maintenance" immediately cuts off every tenant on that cluster, and tenant admins are notified by email.
tips.full: "Full" is computed automatically when used databases reach the maximum.
tips.password: The admin password is stored encrypted and never shown; leave it empty to keep it.

school_admin_dashboard.purpose: This page is the school admin's daily overview: school data completeness, today's attendance, report card flow, subscription seats, and items that need follow-up. All figures come from your school's data.

features.setup: Monitor school data completeness and continue filling incomplete sections.
features.attendance: View today's attendance map per class, then select a class to see students who are sick, excused, or absent.
features.remind: Remind homeroom teachers who have not recorded attendance today.
features.reports: Monitor the active semester report card flow, from locked grades to published PDFs.
features.seats: Monitor student seat usage, students and teachers active in the last 7 days, and storage.
features.follow_up: Jump straight to the related page from the "Needs follow-up" list.

steps.s1: If the data completeness card appears, click "Continue required data" or "Continue filling", or click the name of an unfilled section.
steps.s2: Use "Import students" or "Invite teachers" in the banner to add data quickly.
steps.s3: In "Attendance map · today", click a class tile to see that class's attendance details.
steps.s4: If a class has not recorded attendance, click "Remind homeroom teachers" to send a reminder.
steps.s5: Click "Open class attendance", "Open report cards", or "Add seats" to go to the detail page.
steps.s6: Review "Needs follow-up" and click the action link on each row to resolve it.

tips.required: Teachers and students cannot use FLIXARE until the profile, curriculum, academic year, classes, and subjects are filled.
tips.remind: The "Remind homeroom teachers" button is disabled when the class has no homeroom teacher or a reminder has already been sent.
tips.trial: During the trial, use "Pay & activate" or "View bill" so the school stays active after the trial ends.

school_admin_attendance.purpose: This page monitors which classes have and have not filled attendance, and shows the attendance summary per semester. Attendance is filled by homeroom teachers; admins only monitor it.

features.daily: View daily attendance per class: present, sick, excused, absent, and presence percentage.
features.navigate: Move to previous days to view past attendance.
features.unfilled: See the list of classes that have not filled attendance today.
features.remind: Send a reminder to homeroom teachers who have not filled attendance today.
features.semester: View the semester summary: average presence per class and the number of students absent 3 days or more.

steps.s1: Select the "Daily" tab for attendance by date, or "Semester summary" for the semester overview.
steps.s2: On the "Daily" tab, use the arrow buttons to change the date.
steps.s3: Check the "PRESENCE" column; classes that have not filled attendance are marked "Not yet".
steps.s4: If any class has not filled attendance today, click "Remind homeroom teachers".
steps.s5: In "Semester summary", check "Students absent ≥ 3 days" to follow up with homeroom teachers.

tips.monitor: Admins cannot change attendance entries on this page; homeroom teachers fill them in.
tips.remind_today: The "Remind homeroom teachers" button is only available for today's attendance and changes to "Reminder sent" once sent.
tips.homeroom: Classes without a homeroom teacher are marked "Homeroom teacher not assigned"; assign one on the Classes page.
tips.report: The semester summary is used as attendance data in report cards.

school_admin_audit.purpose: This page shows a trail of important school changes, such as deleted and deactivated records, account invitations, and the report card workflow. Use it to trace who did what and when.

features.timeline: View change history newest first, grouped by day, with the actor and time.
features.category: Filter history by category: teachers & students, guardians, account invitations, or report cards.
features.detail: See extra details such as NIS/NIP, reasons, and the number of invitations sent or failed.
features.more: Load older history step by step.

steps.s1: Select a category tab, for example "Account invitations" or "Report cards".
steps.s2: Fill in "From date" and "To date" to limit the time range.
steps.s3: Read each entry along with its actor and time on the "By …" line.
steps.s4: Click "Load more" to see older history.
steps.s5: Click "Reset filters" to show all history again.

tips.read_only: This page is read-only; history cannot be changed or deleted.
tips.range: The start date cannot be after the end date.
tips.system: Entries with "System" as the actor come from automated processes, not from a user.

school_admin_classes.purpose: This page manages study groups (classes) in the active academic year and their homeroom teachers. Homeroom teachers are required for attendance and report cards.

features.add: Add classes one by one or import many at once from an Excel/CSV file.
features.homeroom: Assign or change the homeroom teacher for each class.
features.find: Search classes by name and filter by grade or classes without a homeroom teacher.
features.capacity: Monitor student counts against class capacity and view the student list of each class.
features.edit: Change a class's grade, name, and capacity, or delete the class.

steps.s1: Make sure an active academic year is set; if not, click "Set academic year".
steps.s2: Click "Add class" to enter one by one, or "Import Excel/CSV", download the template, fill it in, and upload the file.
steps.s3: Select a "Grade", fill in the "Class name", and optionally the "Capacity" and "Homeroom teacher".
steps.s4: Click "Save".
steps.s5: Use the "No homeroom" tab to find classes without a homeroom teacher, then click a row to assign one.

tips.homeroom: A teacher can be homeroom of only one class per academic year.
tips.delete: A class can only be deleted when it has no students, attendance, or report cards.

school_admin_guardians.purpose: This page manages parents/guardians linked to students and invites them to the parent portal. Parents can only see data of their linked children.

features.add: Add parents one by one or import many at once from an Excel/CSV file.
features.link: Link a parent to one or more children, set the primary contact, and remove links.
features.find: Search by name, email, or child name, and filter by primary contact, not invited, or no email.
features.invite: Send portal invitations to parents with an email, one by one or in bulk.
features.edit: Edit parent data or delete it.

steps.s1: Make sure student data exists; the "Add parent" button is enabled only when there is at least one student.
steps.s2: Click "Add parent" to enter one by one, or "Import Excel/CSV", download the template, fill it in, and upload the file.
steps.s3: Fill in "Full name", choose the "Relationship" and "Child", add an "Email" for the portal invitation, then click "Save".
steps.s4: To link another child, open the parent record, choose the child in "Link to child", then click "Save".
steps.s5: Click "Invite … parents" on the list to invite in bulk, or "Send invitation" inside a parent record.

tips.no_email: Parents without an email cannot be invited to the portal.
tips.primary: Each student has only one primary contact.
tips.invite_expiry: Invitation links are valid for 72 hours and single use; use "Resend" if one expires.
tips.delete: Records can only be deleted when they have no history.

principal_dashboard.purpose: This page is the principal's dashboard for monitoring the school and acting on items that need your decision. School data is changed by the school admin and teachers; here you are in view mode.

features.decide: See how many items need your decision, such as class report cards submitted by homeroom teachers and school admin data changes.
features.approvals: Open the approval inbox to review data change requests.
features.reports: Monitor active semester report card status per step and open class report cards awaiting approval or ready to lock.
features.subscription: View the plan, subscription status, and student seat quota usage.

steps.s1: Check "Needs your decision" in the banner and click the row you want to act on.
steps.s2: Click "Open approval inbox" to review data change requests.
steps.s3: In "Report card approval", click a class marked "Pending" or "Ready to lock" to open its report cards.
steps.s4: Click "Review" to see all class report cards.
steps.s5: Monitor "Subscription & seat quota"; adding seats is done by the school admin.

tips.sample: Sections labeled "Sample data" are not connected to school data yet; figures are samples and actions are not saved.
tips.report_error: If a message says report card data could not be loaded, reload the page.

school_admin_reports.purpose: This page tracks report card progress for every class in the active academic year, from draft to locked. Report cards are prepared by homeroom teachers and approved by the principal; here you monitor them, send reminders, and download PDFs.

features.monitor: See each class's report status: "Draft", "Submitted", "Approved", or "Locked · PDF", along with how many subjects have locked final grades.
features.filter: Filter classes by status using the tabs above the table.
features.remind: Send a reminder to the homeroom teacher for report cards still in draft.
features.review: Open the class report review for submitted report cards to see the details and follow up.
features.download: Download the report card PDF for a locked class.

steps.s1: Check the summary of report cards per status at the top of the page.
steps.s2: Choose a status tab to show the classes you want to monitor.
steps.s3: For classes in "Draft", click "Remind" so the homeroom teacher completes and submits the report card.
steps.s4: For submitted or approved classes, click "View" to open the class report review.
steps.s5: Once the status is "Locked · PDF", click "Download PDF" to download that class's report cards.

tips.homeroom: The "Remind" button is disabled when no homeroom teacher is assigned. Assign one in the class data first.
tips.locked_subjects: A report card cannot be submitted while any subject still lacks locked final grades.
tips.correction: Locked report cards can only be corrected after the principal unlocks them, and this is recorded in the audit log.

school_admin_report_class.purpose: This page shows the review of one class's report card: status history, subject grade progress, and each student's grades and notes. From here the report card is processed according to your role and its status, from approval to locking and issuing PDFs.

features.timeline: See the "Status history": when the report card was submitted by the homeroom teacher, approved by the principal, and locked, and by whom.
features.subjects: Track "Subject grade progress" to make sure every subject has locked its final grades.
features.students: Review "Student grades & notes": grades per subject, average, attendance summary (sick, permit, absent), and the homeroom teacher's note.
features.decide: Approve, return to the homeroom teacher, lock, or unlock the report card. The buttons shown depend on your role and the report status.
features.pdf: Download the report card PDF for the whole class or per student once it is locked.

steps.s1: Read the status and hint in the "Status history" card to see the current stage.
steps.s2: Check "Subject grade progress" and the "Student grades & notes" table; click "Show more" to read long homeroom notes.
steps.s3: If something needs fixing, click "Return", write the reason, and confirm to send the report card back to draft.
steps.s4: If the report card is correct, click "Approve" and confirm.
steps.s5: For an approved report card, click "Lock & issue PDFs" and confirm with "Lock report card" so grades become final and PDFs are issued.
steps.s6: Once locked, click "Download class PDF" or the "PDF" button on a student row to download report cards.

tips.reason: The reason for returning or unlocking must be 10–500 characters and is sent to the homeroom teacher.
tips.approve_final: An approved report card can no longer be returned. Corrections are made by unlocking after it is published.
tips.unlock: "Unlock" sends the report card back to draft, increases its version, and is recorded in the audit log.
tips.role: If no action buttons appear, the current stage is not within your role or is still waiting for the homeroom teacher.

school_admin_subscription.purpose: This page shows the school's subscription plan, student seat usage, and recent invoices. Use it to add seats when the number of active students approaches the subscription limit.

features.plan: See the plan, price per student, subscription status, and the period or trial window.
features.seats: Track "Student seats used" against available seats, including seats awaiting payment.
features.add_seats: Add seats at a prorated cost based on the remaining full months in the current period.
features.activate: Open the activation page with "Pay & activate subscription" during the trial.
features.invoices: See recent invoices and open their details on the invoices page.

steps.s1: Check the subscription status and seat usage on the plan card.
steps.s2: If you are still on trial, click "Pay & activate subscription" to activate the full subscription.
steps.s3: To add seats, set the number in the "Add seats" section using "Decrease"/"Increase" or by typing it.
steps.s4: Review the prorated cost, then click the add seats button below it.
steps.s5: If a prorated invoice is issued, use "Open invoices page" or click the invoice in the list to pay it.

tips.no_confirm: The add seats button processes the request immediately without a confirmation dialog. Make sure the number of seats is right before clicking.
tips.paid_first: Outside the trial, extra seats only activate once the prorated invoice is paid.
tips.trial: During the trial, extra seats activate immediately and are billed at activation.
tips.inactive: Inactive students are not counted as seats. New students are rejected when seats are full.

school_admin_teachers.purpose: This page manages the school's teacher records and their sign-in accounts. New teachers can sign in to FLIXARE after receiving and opening their invitation.

features.add: Add teachers one by one or import many at once from an Excel/CSV file.
features.find: Search teachers by name, email, or NIP, and filter by account status.
features.edit: Edit teacher details, deactivate teachers, or delete teachers who have no history.
features.assignments: See each teacher's number of teaching assignments and homeroom class.
features.invite: Send account invitations to one teacher or to all teachers who have not been invited yet.

steps.s1: Click "Add teacher" to enter one at a time, or "Import Excel/CSV" to import many teachers at once.
steps.s2: Fill in the fields marked * (full name, gender, and email), then click "Save".
steps.s3: Use the search field and the "All", "Active", "Invited", or "Not invited" tabs to find teachers.
steps.s4: Click a teacher row to open the details, edit the data, or see the list of teaching assignments.
steps.s5: Click "Invite … teachers" on the bar above the list to invite all uninvited teachers at once, or use "Send invitation" in the teacher details.
steps.s6: If an invitation has expired, open the teacher details and click "Resend".

tips.email: The email is used for invitations and sign-in, and cannot be changed once the teacher is invited or the account is active.
tips.expiry: Invitation links are valid for 72 hours and can only be used once.
tips.delete: A teacher can only be deleted if they have no history. Otherwise, deactivate them to keep their teaching history.
tips.bulk: Invitations for more than 50 accounts are processed in stages; progress appears on this page.

school_admin_years.purpose: This page sets up the school's academic years and semesters. Only one academic year and one semester are active; classes, grades, attendance, and report cards are tied to the active year.

features.overview: See the active academic year, the active semester and its dates, and the number of classes this year.
features.add: Add a new academic year with odd and even semester dates.
features.activate: Set which academic year and semester are active.
features.copy: Copy class names and grade levels from the active year when creating a new academic year.
features.edit: Change an academic year's dates, or delete an inactive academic year that has no classes.

steps.s1: Click "Add academic year"; the form is prefilled with a suggestion for the next year.
steps.s2: Check the "Academic year name" (format YYYY/YYYY), the "Start" and "End" dates, and the start and end dates of the odd and even semesters.
steps.s3: Choose the "Active semester" ("Odd" or "Even") and set "Status" to "Active" if this year will be used right away.
steps.s4: For a new academic year, decide whether to copy classes from the active year.
steps.s5: Click "Save", then click an academic year row whenever you need to edit it again.

tips.one_active: Activating one academic year deactivates the others. The active year cannot be deactivated until another year is activated.
tips.dates: Semester dates must be in order: the odd semester ends before the even semester starts.
tips.copy: Students are not copied; promotion is done separately.
tips.delete: The active academic year, or one that already has classes, cannot be deleted.

account_settings.purpose: This page manages the details and security of the account you use to sign in to FLIXARE, from your profile and password to devices, notifications, and data privacy.

features.profile: Update your profile photo and personal details in "My profile". Some details are managed by your institution or need approval before they apply.
features.password: Change your password with OTP verification in "Manage password", or request a reset link if you forgot your current password.
features.security: Turn on 2-step verification and save backup codes in "Security & 2-step".
features.sessions: Review signed-in devices and 30 days of sign-in activity, and sign out devices you do not recognize.
features.notif: Choose notification channels per event and set quiet hours in "Notification preferences".
features.privacy: Link other accounts for signing in, control who sees your data, download a copy of your data, or request account deletion.

steps.s1: Choose a menu on the left (or scroll the menu on small screens) for the section you want to change.
steps.s2: In "My profile", update the details you are allowed to change, then click "Save profile".
steps.s3: To change your password, open "Manage password", enter your current and new password, click "Continue to OTP verification", and enter the code.
steps.s4: Open "Security & 2-step", click "Turn on 2-step verification", and follow the three steps until your backup codes are saved.
steps.s5: In "Devices & active sessions", click "Sign out" on any device you do not recognize.
steps.s6: Set your notifications in "Notification preferences", then click "Save preferences".

tips.dot: A warning dot on a menu means something needs your attention, such as 2-step verification being off or a request that needs documents.
tips.approval: Changes that need approval only apply once approved; a new email only applies after the verification link is opened.
tips.security_notif: Security notifications by email are always on and cannot be turned off.
tips.not_me: If you see a suspicious sign-in in your history, change your password and turn on 2-step verification right away.

approvals_school.purpose: This page is the approvals inbox for name, identity number, and account deletion requests at your school. School admins review requests from teachers, students, parents, and the principal, while the principal reviews requests from school admins.

features.queue: See requests in the "Pending", "Documents needed", and "Done" tabs, with the remaining deadline.
features.filter: Filter requests by type ("Full name", "Identity number", "Delete account") and search by requester name.
features.review: Open request details: current data, requested change, the requester's reason, attachments, and history.
features.decide: Approve, decline with a reason, or ask the requester for additional documents.
features.bulk: Approve several requests at once from the "Pending" tab.

steps.s1: Open the "Pending" tab and handle requests that are close to or past the deadline first.
steps.s2: Click the requester's name to open the details, then check the requested change and attachments.
steps.s3: Choose a decision: "Approve", "Decline", or "Request documents".
steps.s4: To decline, choose a reason; to request documents, choose the documents needed and add a message if necessary.
steps.s5: Click the button to submit your decision, then confirm if asked.
steps.s6: To approve many requests at once, tick them in the "Pending" tab and click "Approve selected".

tips.sla: The review deadline is 3 working days after the request is submitted.
tips.docs: Requesting documents pauses the deadline until the requester uploads them.
tips.self: You cannot decide on your own request; it is processed by another reviewer.
tips.other_reason: If you choose the "Other" reason, an explanation of at least 10 characters is required.

approvals_platform.purpose: This page is the super admin approvals inbox for name, employee ID, and account deletion requests from platform console users.

features.queue: See requests in the "Pending", "Documents needed", and "Done" tabs, with the remaining deadline.
features.filter: Filter requests by type and search by requester name.
features.review: Open request details: current data, requested change, the requester's reason, attachments, and history.
features.decide: Approve, decline with a reason, or ask the requester for additional documents.
features.bulk: Approve several requests at once from the "Pending" tab.

steps.s1: Open the "Pending" tab and handle requests that are close to or past the deadline first.
steps.s2: Click the requester's name to open the details, then check the requested change and attachments.
steps.s3: Choose a decision: "Approve", "Decline", or "Request documents".
steps.s4: To decline, choose a reason; to request documents, choose the documents needed and add a message if necessary.
steps.s5: Click the button to submit your decision, then confirm if asked.
steps.s6: To approve many requests at once, tick them in the "Pending" tab and click "Approve selected".

tips.sla: The review deadline is 3 working days after the request is submitted.
tips.docs: Requesting documents pauses the deadline until the requester uploads them.
tips.self: You cannot decide on your own request; it is processed by another reviewer.
tips.deletion: Accounts whose deletion is approved are deactivated 30 days after approval.

tenant_billing.purpose: This page shows the invoices FLIXARE has issued to your institution. From here you can view the details, pay, and print invoices or receipts.

features.list: See the list of invoices with their status, amount, and due date.
features.detail: Open invoice details: issue date, due date, period, line items, and total.
features.online: Pay via a Virtual Account at your chosen bank or via QRIS, then check the payment status.
features.transfer: Pay by bank transfer and send the transfer proof for verification by the FLIXARE finance team.
features.print: Print or save the invoice as a PDF, and print a receipt for paid invoices.

steps.s1: Choose an invoice from the list on the left to open its details.
steps.s2: In the "How to pay" section, choose "Virtual Account", "QRIS", or "Bank transfer".
steps.s3: For a Virtual Account, choose a bank and click "Create … VA number"; for QRIS, click "Show QRIS code".
steps.s4: Pay before the instructions expire, then click "I have paid, check status".
steps.s5: For a bank transfer, transfer to the account shown, fill in the transfer details, upload the proof, and click "Send transfer proof".
steps.s6: Click "Print / PDF" to print the invoice, or "Print receipt" once the invoice is paid.

tips.verification: Bank transfer payments are only marked as paid after the FLIXARE finance team verifies the proof.
tips.partial: The transfer amount may be partial, up to the remaining balance.
tips.proof: The transfer proof must be a PDF, PNG, or JPG file of at most 5 MB.
tips.overdue: Pay overdue invoices promptly so the service is not restricted.

teacher_dashboard.purpose: The Teacher Workspace home summarizes your teaching day as a subject teacher: the current date and time, active semester, today's teaching schedule, and students' final scores per class and subject.

features.overview: See the greeting, date, and active semester at the top of the page.
features.preview: See "Today's agenda" from the school timetable and the "Gradebook" with students' final scores and each subject's passing criteria. The grading pile and assessment sessions appear once their modules are available.
features.grades: Open the "Final grades" menu in the sidebar to enter and lock report card final grades.
features.role: Switch to the homeroom view with the role toggle at the top of the screen if you are also a homeroom teacher.

steps.s1: Check the date and active semester at the top of the page.
steps.s2: Check "Today's agenda" for your lessons, then the "Gradebook" for scores that are missing or below the passing criteria.
steps.s3: To enter report card final grades, click the "Final grades" menu in the sidebar.
steps.s4: If you are also a homeroom teacher, choose "Homeroom teacher" on the role toggle at the top of the screen to open the Homeroom Workspace.

tips.sample: Sections whose modules are not available yet stay empty. During development (dev), sections labeled "Sample data" are simulations only and are not saved.
tips.disabled: The "Create assignment" and "Question bank" buttons are not active yet because their modules are not available.

teacher_grade_sheet.purpose: Use this grade sheet to enter the final grade and achievement description for each student in one class and subject you teach. Once locked, the grades are used by the homeroom teacher to compile report cards.

features.fill: Enter a final grade of 0–100 (decimals allowed) and an achievement description of up to 500 characters for each student.
features.summary: Track the "Passing grade", the number of "Grades entered", and students "Below passing grade" in the summary cards.
features.save: Save grades gradually with the "Save" button and continue later.
features.lock: Lock the grades with the "Lock grades" button once every student's grade and description are complete.
features.view: View locked grades and the class report status in read-only mode.

steps.s1: Open the grade sheet from the "Final grades" page by clicking "Enter grades" on the class and subject you want.
steps.s2: Fill in the "Final grade" (0–100) for each student; grades below the passing grade are highlighted.
steps.s3: Write the "Achievement description" for each student who has a grade.
steps.s4: Click "Save" to store your changes; grades can be saved partially.
steps.s5: Once all students are complete, click "Lock grades" and confirm with "Lock grades" in the dialog.
steps.s6: Click "Back to list" to check the status of your other grade sheets.

tips.description: An achievement description is only saved once that student's grade is entered.
tips.rounding: Grades are rounded to 2 decimal places.
tips.autosave: Unsaved changes are saved automatically first when you lock the grades.
tips.locked: Locked grades can no longer be changed; only the principal can reopen them.

homeroom_dashboard.purpose: The Homeroom Workspace home summarizes your tasks as a homeroom teacher, including the semester report status of your homeroom class. Other sections labeled "Sample data" are still previews because their modules are not available yet.

features.report: Track the status and completeness of your homeroom class's semester report: locked subjects and the number of homeroom notes written.
features.open_report: Open the class report page with the "Open class report" or "View class report" button.
features.attendance: Record daily attendance that is actually saved through the "Class attendance" menu in the sidebar.
features.preview: Explore daily attendance, "Parent requests", "Liaison book", "Grade recap for all subjects", "Students needing attention", the class schedule, and "Behavior & counseling notes" as sample data.
features.role: Switch back to the subject teacher view with the role toggle at the top of the screen.

steps.s1: Check your homeroom class name and the date at the top of the page.
steps.s2: Review the semester report card to see which subjects are not locked yet and which notes are incomplete.
steps.s3: Click "Open class report" to write homeroom notes and submit the report.
steps.s4: To record daily attendance that is saved, click the "Class attendance" menu in the sidebar.
steps.s5: To enter grades for subjects you teach, click the "Subject final grades" menu in the sidebar.

tips.sample: Entries and actions in sections labeled "Sample data", such as "Fill in attendance", "Approval inbox", liaison book replies, or saving behavior notes, are simulations only and are not saved.
tips.attendance: Only attendance recorded on the "Class attendance" page is saved and used for the report summary.
tips.report_unavailable: If the report card shows "Unavailable", open the class report page to reload its status.

homeroom_attendance.purpose: Homeroom teachers use this page to record daily attendance for their homeroom class. Each student has one record per date, and the summary is used for report cards and monitored by the school admin.

features.bulk: Mark every student at once with the "Mark all present" button.
features.note: Add a short note per student (optional, up to 200 characters).
features.date: Move to the previous or next day with the arrow buttons to fill in or correct attendance.
features.summary: See the number of students per status in the summary cards at the top.

steps.s1: Make sure the displayed date is correct; use the arrow buttons to change days.
steps.s2: Click "Mark all present" if most students are present.
steps.s3: Change the status of absent students to "Sick", "Excused", or "Absent".
steps.s4: Fill in "Note (optional)" if extra information is needed.
steps.s5: Click "Save attendance"; the "Filled" label appears for that date.
steps.s6: To make corrections, change the entries and click "Update attendance".

tips.default: Students without an entry default to "Present", so double-check before saving.
tips.future: Attendance cannot be recorded for dates after today or on holidays.
tips.follow_up: School admins monitor this summary; students absent for 3 or more days need follow-up.

homeroom_report.purpose: Homeroom teachers use this page to prepare the homeroom class report card: write a note for each student, check that subject grades are complete, then submit the report to the principal.

features.notes: Write a "Homeroom note" for each student (up to 1000 characters).
features.review: See each student's average, subject grades, and sick/permit/absent summary.
features.checklist: Check "Report completeness" and the lock status of each subject along with its teacher.
features.submit: Submit the report with the "Submit to principal" button once all requirements are met.
features.history: Track the "Submission history": submitted, approved, and locked.

steps.s1: Check the "Report completeness" panel to see which subjects' grades are not locked yet.
steps.s2: Write a progress and attitude note in each student's "Homeroom note" field.
steps.s3: Click "Save notes"; notes can be saved gradually.
steps.s4: Once all subject grades are locked and notes are complete, click "Submit to principal" and confirm.
steps.s5: Track the report status and "Submission history" until the report is approved and locked.

tips.subjects: If a subject is "Not locked", ask its subject teacher to lock the final grades first.
tips.readonly: While the principal is reviewing, notes cannot be changed unless the report is returned.
tips.returned: If the report is returned, read the return note at the top, make corrections, then resubmit.
tips.attendance: The attendance summary is calculated automatically from daily attendance, so make sure class attendance has been recorded.

guardian_dashboard.purpose: The Guardian Portal home is designed to summarize your child's activities, scores, attendance, and messages from the homeroom teacher. For now, all of its content is sample data because the data service is not connected yet.

features.child: Switch between children with the child name buttons at the top of the page.
features.preview: Explore the "Liaison book", "Scores this semester", monthly attendance, and "Upcoming" sections as sample data.
features.report: Open the "Report cards" menu in the sidebar to see your child's official report cards published by the school.

steps.s1: Choose a child with the name buttons at the top of the page if you have more than one child.
steps.s2: Browse the home sections to get to know the portal; the figures shown do not reflect your child's data yet.
steps.s3: To see official grades and report cards, click the "Report cards" menu in the sidebar.

tips.sample: The "I've reminded them" button and "Liaison book" replies are simulations only and are not sent to the homeroom teacher.
tips.unavailable: The "Details" link and menus without a page cannot be opened yet.

learner_reports_student.purpose: This page shows your report cards published by the school: final grades, competency achievements, absences, and the homeroom teacher's note. You can also follow the progress of the current semester's report card.

features.progress: Follow the current semester's report stages, from "Grades & notes prepared" to "Report published".
features.summary: See the "Average score", number of subjects, subjects "Below passing grade", and total absences.
features.subjects: Read the final grade and achievement description for each subject, along with its passing grade.
features.note: Read the "Homeroom teacher's note" and the sick, excused, and unexcused absence summary.
features.download: Download the report document with the "Download report PDF" button.

steps.s1: Check the current semester's report status to see which stage it has reached.
steps.s2: If more than one report card is published, choose a semester from the "Semester … · …" tabs.
steps.s3: Review the summary cards, then read the grades and achievements under "Final grades & competency achievements".
steps.s4: Read the "Homeroom teacher's note" and the "Absences" summary.
steps.s5: Click "Download report PDF" to save the report document.

tips.published: Report cards appear only after the school approves and publishes them.
tips.pdf: If it says "The report PDF is not available yet", contact the school administrator.
tips.linked: If "Student record not linked" appears, ask the school administrator to link your account to your student record.

learner_reports_guardian.purpose: This page shows your child's report cards published by the school: final grades, competency achievements, absences, and the homeroom teacher's note. You can also follow the progress of the current semester's report card.

features.child: Switch between children with the child name tabs if more than one child is linked to your account.
features.progress: Follow the current semester's report stages, from "Grades & notes prepared" to "Report published".
features.summary: See the "Average score", number of subjects, subjects "Below passing grade", and total absences.
features.subjects: Read the final grades, achievement descriptions, and "Homeroom teacher's note" for each report card.
features.download: Download the report document with the "Download report PDF" button.

steps.s1: If you have more than one child, choose a child from the tabs at the top.
steps.s2: Check the current semester's report status to see which stage it has reached.
steps.s3: If more than one report card is published, choose a semester from the "Semester … · …" tabs.
steps.s4: Review the grades, achievements, "Absences" summary, and "Homeroom teacher's note".
steps.s5: Click "Download report PDF" to save the report document.

tips.published: Report cards appear only after the school approves and publishes them.
tips.pdf: If it says "The report PDF is not available yet", contact the school administrator.
tips.linked: If "No linked children yet" appears, ask the school administrator to link your child to your account.

student_dashboard.purpose: This home page sums up your school day: today's assessments, level and XP, this week's tasks, subject progress, recent scores, remedials, and attendance history.

features.mission: See the "TODAY'S MISSION" card with your next assessment, its time, number of questions, XP reward, and a countdown to the start.
features.level: Track your level, XP toward the next level, and your learning streak for the week.
features.quests: See "This week's tasks" with their deadlines and XP.
features.subjects: See progress per subject in "Subject collection" and scores in "Recent scores".
features.improve: Check "Needs remedial" and "To improve this semester" to find topics still below target.
features.attendance: See the monthly "Attendance history" calendar with the rate and count of each status.

steps.s1: Read the greeting and the "TODAY'S MISSION" card to see whether you have an assessment today and when it starts.
steps.s2: Check "This week's tasks"; a red deadline means it is urgent.
steps.s3: Look at "Subject collection" and "Recent scores" to track your progress.
steps.s4: Open "Needs remedial" and click an item in "To improve this semester" to read its study tip.
steps.s5: Pick a month in "Attendance history" to see your attendance calendar.

tips.simulation: The "Start assessment" button, task checkboxes, and "Start remedial" are not connected to the exam or task system yet: when enabled, they only show a simulation notice that is not saved.
tips.target: The thin line on a score bar marks the mastery target; aim to get past it.

student_assessments.purpose: This page shows the schedule of quizzes, summative tests, tryouts, and remedial exams for your class, with duration, number of questions, passing score (KKM), and results.

features.summary: See a summary of exams: total, active today, upcoming, and needing remedial.
features.filter: Filter exams by subject and status ("Aktif Hari Ini", "Mendatang", "Riwayat & Nilai", "Remedial").
features.search: Search exams by title, room code, subject, or teacher name.
features.detail: Open an exam to read its duration, number of questions, KKM, proctor, and rules.
features.result: See the score and the "Lulus KKM" or "Perlu Remedial" status of finished exams.

steps.s1: Pick a subject or status tab, or type in the search box to find an exam.
steps.s2: Look for cards marked "● Ujian Dibuka" for exams that are open today.
steps.s3: Click the card button ("Mulai Ujian Sekarang", "Mulai Ujian Remedial", "Lihat Jadwal & Petunjuk", or "Lihat Pembahasan & Nilai") to open its details.
steps.s4: Read "Tata Tertib & Petunjuk Ujian" before clicking "Konfirmasi & Masuk Ujian".
steps.s5: Click "Tutup" or "Keluar Sesi" to go back to the list.

tips.simulation: The exam session on this page is still a visual simulation: there are no questions to answer yet and no answers are saved.
tips.reset: If the list is empty, click "Reset Semua Filter" to show all exams again.

student_attendance.purpose: This page sums up your attendance: attendance rate, late arrivals, leave, sick days, the daily attendance log, and your leave request history.

features.summary: See your semester attendance rate, learning streak, late arrivals, and leave/sick days.
features.month: Pick a month to see days present, late, on leave, sick, and absent.
features.log: Read the "Log Presensi Harian" with check-in time, check-out time, status, and notes.
features.history: See the "Riwayat Pengajuan Izin & Surat Keterangan Sakit" and its attachments.
features.permit: Fill in the "Request Leave / Sick" form with the type, dates, reason, and an attachment.

steps.s1: Check the attendance summary at the top of the page.
steps.s2: Pick a month from the month buttons to see that month's summary.
steps.s3: Scroll to "Log Presensi Harian" to see the record for each day.
steps.s4: For leave or sick days, click "Request Leave / Sick", choose the type, fill in the dates and reason, then attach a letter.
steps.s5: Click "Kirim Permohonan" to close the form.

tips.not_sent: The leave/sick form is still a sample view: the request is not actually sent to your homeroom teacher or duty teacher and does not appear in the history. Keep using the school's official channel to report leave.
tips.empty_log: The daily log is only available for months that already have details; other months show only the totals.

student_materials.purpose: This page holds learning materials from your teachers, such as videos, PDF modules, slides, and article summaries, together with your learning progress.

features.summary: See the number of materials, how many you have finished, and how many are in progress.
features.filter: Filter materials by subject and format ("Video", "PDF", "Slide").
features.search: Search materials by title, chapter, topic code, description, or subject.
features.progress: See each material's status and progress bar ("Selesai", a percentage, or "Belum dibuka").
features.detail: Open a material's summary, learning objectives, duration, and teacher.

steps.s1: Pick a subject or format, or type a keyword in the search box.
steps.s2: Check the progress on each card to find unfinished materials.
steps.s3: Click "Buka Materi" to read its summary and learning objectives.
steps.s4: Click "Tutup" to go back to the list.

tips.not_ready: The "Pelajari Sekarang" and "Unduh Berkas" buttons do not open or download a file yet; for now they only close the detail window.
tips.reset: If no materials are shown, click "Reset Semua Filter".

student_messages.purpose: This page is your message room with your homeroom teacher, subject teachers, and the class announcement channel.

features.contacts: See the "Daftar Guru & Saluran" list with each last message and unread count.
features.filter: Filter contacts with the "Semua", "Guru", or "Pengumuman" tabs.
features.search: Search teachers by name, role, or last message.
features.read: Read conversation history and school announcements.
features.compose: Write a message in the input field at the bottom of the chat room.

steps.s1: Pick a tab or search for a teacher in the left panel.
steps.s2: Click a contact to open the conversation.
steps.s3: Read messages and announcements in the chat room on the right.
steps.s4: To reply, type a message in the bottom field, then press Enter or click the send button; remember that the message is not actually sent yet (see the notes).

tips.not_sent: Sending messages is not connected to the server yet: what you write is not sent to your teacher and is not saved. For anything important, contact your teacher through the school's official channel.
tips.not_ready: The call, video, contact info, and attachment buttons do not work yet.

platform_invoices.purpose: This page is for creating, issuing, and tracking tenant invoices, including recording and verifying their payments. Issued invoices are locked and cannot be changed.

features.find: Search invoices by number or tenant name, and filter by status: "All", "Drafts", "Unpaid", "Overdue", or "Paid".
features.draft: Prepare a draft invoice: tenant, issue date, "Terms", "Service period", line items (auto-filled with "Fill from tenant subscription"), discount, 11% VAT, and "Destination account".
features.issue: Check the layout with "Preview & print" (print or save as PDF), then issue an officially numbered invoice and email it to the PIC with "Issue & send".
features.follow: Follow up on issued invoices: "Send reminder", "Record payment" for funds already received, or "Void invoice".
features.proof: Review transfer proofs sent by tenants, then choose "Verify" or "Reject" with a reason.
features.settings: Set the letterhead, signer, default terms, Virtual Account bank, default note, and destination accounts in "Issuer settings".

steps.s1: Click "New invoice", then choose the tenant in the "Tenant" field.
steps.s2: Set the issue date, "Terms", and "Service period". Add line items with "Add row" or click "Fill from tenant subscription".
steps.s3: Adjust the discount, VAT, "Destination account", and note if needed, then click "Save draft".
steps.s4: Click "Preview & print" to check the invoice before issuing it.
steps.s5: Click "Issue & send" and confirm. The invoice gets an official number and is emailed to the tenant PIC.
steps.s6: Once funds arrive, click "Record payment" or verify the tenant's transfer proof. The status becomes "Paid" when the payment is sufficient.

tips.locked: Issued invoices cannot be changed. To correct one, void it (reason of at least 5 characters) and create a new one, for example with "Duplicate as draft".
tips.sample: If a warning says the letterhead still uses sample data, complete "Issuer settings" before issuing invoices.
tips.reminder: A reminder can only be sent again 1 hour after the last one.
tips.delete: Only drafts can be deleted, using "Delete draft". Drafts have no number, so no invoice number gap is left.

platform_payments.purpose: This page is for verifying transfer proofs sent by tenants and recording manual payments received outside the system. VA and QRIS payments through the gateway are verified automatically.

features.find: Search payments by tenant, invoice number, or reference, and filter by tab: "Verify", "All", "Verified", or "Rejected".
features.compare: Compare the amount paid with the invoice's remaining balance and see the difference.
features.proof: View the transfer proof and payment details: method, time, sender, reference, invoice, and due date.
features.mutation: Record that a payment has been matched against the bank statement with "Mark as checked".
features.decide: Verify a payment so it is recorded to the invoice, or reject it with a reason that is emailed to the tenant PIC.
features.manual: Record a manual payment ("Bank transfer", "Virtual account", "QRIS", or "Cash / cheque") with "Record payment".

steps.s1: Open the "Verify" tab, then click the payment you want to review.
steps.s2: Check the transfer proof, the payment details, and the difference from the remaining balance.
steps.s3: Match it against the bank statement, then click "Mark as checked".
steps.s4: In the "Action" section, choose "Verify" or "Reject". To reject, pick one of the rejection reasons.
steps.s5: Click "Verify payment" or "Reject payment", then confirm.
steps.s6: For payments outside the system, click "Record payment", choose the invoice, enter the amount, date, method, and sender details, attach the proof, then click "Save & verify".

tips.partial: If the amount is less than the remaining balance, it is recorded as a partial payment and the invoice stays unpaid.
tips.proof: Proof is required for "Bank transfer" unless you tick "Checked against the bank statement". Files must be JPG, PNG, or PDF, max 5 MB.
tips.limits: The recorded amount cannot exceed the remaining balance, and the date received cannot be in the future.
tips.manual: Manual payments are verified immediately once saved.

platform_applications.purpose: This page is for reviewing new institution applications from the sign-up page: check and correct the details, complete verification, then approve, request changes, or reject. The tenant database is created automatically after approval.

features.queue: View the queue by status ("Waiting", "Revision", "Approved", "Rejected") and search by name or NPSN. Waiting applications show their age and SLA progress.
features.edit: Correct application details (institution name, level, time zone, seats or participants, address, and PIC contact) and open attached files.
features.checks: Complete "Verification": some items are checked automatically, others are ticked manually, including "Mark as not duplicate".
features.decide: Decide on the application: "Approve" (choose plan, trial, and database cluster), "Request changes" (choose sections and write a message), or "Reject" (choose a reason).
features.reopen: Reopen a rejected application with "Reopen", or return a revised application to the queue with "Mark as fixed".
features.provisioning: Track the progress of preparing the tenant database after approval.

steps.s1: In the "Waiting" tab, click an application in the left list.
steps.s2: Review the application details and correct them if needed. Open the attachments to check the documents.
steps.s3: Complete every item in the "Verification" section by ticking the manual checks.
steps.s4: In the "Decision" section, choose "Approve", "Request changes", or "Reject", then fill in the requested details.
steps.s5: Click the decision button at the bottom, for example "Approve & create database", then confirm.
steps.s6: Follow the result in the "Approved", "Revision", or "Rejected" tab.

tips.checks: "Approve" is only possible after every verification item is met.
tips.edits: Corrections are saved when the decision is confirmed. Click "Discard changes" to restore the original details.
tips.paid: A paid plan without a trial issues the first invoice right away; the database is prepared once the invoice is paid.
tips.notify: The change request message (at least 10 characters) and rejection reason are emailed to the applicant's PIC.

registration.purpose: This page guides you through registering your institution with FLIXARE, from creating an account, choosing a plan, and paying or starting a trial, to the initial setup before entering the dashboard.

features.type: Choose the institution type: "School", "Private tutor", or "Session organizer". The steps and requirements follow the selected type.
features.account: Create the account of the person in charge and verify it with a 6-digit code.
features.plan: Fill in the institution details, then choose a plan, number of seats, "Monthly" or "Yearly" cycle, and a trial when available.
features.pay: Pay the invoice via Virtual Account or QRIS, then check the payment status.
features.status: Follow the approval and database activation status; it refreshes automatically.
features.setup: Complete the initial setup for your institution type, such as profile, academic year, classes, and subjects.

steps.s1: Choose the institution type, enter the person in charge and password, tick the agreement, then click "Send verification code".
steps.s2: Enter the 6-digit code you received. Click "Resend code" if it has not arrived.
steps.s3: Complete the institution details (a school's NPSN is checked automatically), then click "Continue to plan".
steps.s4: Choose the plan, number of seats, and billing cycle, then continue to the payment step.
steps.s5: For a trial, click "Request trial". For a paid plan, choose Virtual Account or QRIS, pay the invoice, then click "I have paid, check status".
steps.s6: Wait for approval and database activation, then click "Start initial setup".
steps.s7: Fill in each setup step and click "Save & continue", then click "Go to dashboard" on the last step.

tips.review: School applications are reviewed by the FLIXARE team (target ≤ 1 business day); for paid plans, the invoice can only be paid after approval. Private tutors and session organizers are approved automatically.
tips.revision: If the team requests changes, click "Fix details" and update the requested institution details.
tips.import: Importing teachers and students from Excel is not available yet. Choose "Skip for now" and add them from the dashboard.

platform_dashboard.purpose: This page summarizes the state of the FLIXARE platform: key metrics, the application queue, database cluster capacity, the provisioning log, revenue, billing, and churn risk.

features.period: Switch the summary metrics period: "7 days", "30 days", or "90 days".
features.queue: View the "Application queue" with each application's age and SLA usage.
features.infra: Monitor "DB clusters" capacity and the tenant database "Provisioning log".
features.revenue: View the "Monthly revenue" chart and each month's details.
features.billing: View the invoice status breakdown under "Billing" and the "Churn risk" list.
features.plans: Open subscription plan management with the "Manage plans" button.

steps.s1: Choose a period at the top right to change the range of the summary metrics.
steps.s2: Check the metric cards below the title for a quick view of the platform.
steps.s3: Review the "Application queue". Approve or reject decisions are made on the "Institution applications" page.
steps.s4: Monitor "DB clusters" and the "Provisioning log" to make sure capacity and database setup are running normally.
steps.s5: Click a bar in "Monthly revenue" to see that month's details, then check "Billing" and "Churn risk".

tips.data: The backend data source for this dashboard is not available yet, so the figures shown are still sample data.

platform_master_data.purpose: This page is for managing the reference (master) data used by every tenant, such as institutions, education levels, academic years, curriculum, subjects, users, roles, permissions, and notification templates.

features.pick: Choose a master from the left list, grouped by section, and find it with "Search masters".
features.find: Search records by name or code and filter by status: "All", "Active", "Inactive", or "Archived".
features.edit: Add new records with the "Add" button and edit a record by clicking its row.
features.template: For notification templates, insert variables into the message and see a preview.
features.csv: Export the selected master with "Export CSV".

steps.s1: Choose the master you want to manage in the left list.
steps.s2: Find records with "Search name or code" or filter by status.
steps.s3: Click the "Add" button (followed by the master name) for a new record, or click a row to edit it.
steps.s4: Fill in the fields marked * in the panel, choose a status, then click "Save".
steps.s5: To delete, open the record, click "Delete data", and confirm.

tips.in_use: Records still used by other data cannot be deleted. Change the status to "Archived" so they no longer appear in new choices.
tips.inactive: "Inactive" temporarily hides a record from new choices; existing data keeps using it.
tips.code: The code is locked after creation so references from other data stay intact.

platform_navigation.purpose: This page is for arranging the sidebar menu of each role (Platform, School admin, Teacher, Student, and Parent): groups, order, routes, icons, and menu visibility.

features.role: Choose the role whose sidebar you want to arrange. A dot marks roles with unsaved changes.
features.tree: Add groups and menus with "New group" and "New menu", search menus, reorder them with the arrow buttons, and hide menus with the eye icon.
features.editor: Edit menu or group details: name, status, "Parent group", "Open in", "Route", counter next to the menu, icon, and group behavior.
features.preview: See a live sidebar preview; click a menu in the preview to edit it.
features.reset: Restore a role's sidebar to the "Default layout".

steps.s1: Choose the role whose sidebar you want to arrange.
steps.s2: Click "New group" or "New menu", or select a group/menu in the list to edit it.
steps.s3: Fill in the name, route, icon, and other settings in the editor panel.
steps.s4: Reorder with the arrow buttons and set visibility with the eye icon.
steps.s5: Check the result in the sidebar preview.
steps.s6: Click "Save … sidebar" (with the role name) to save, or "Discard" to drop your changes.

tips.access: Hiding a menu does not revoke access; the server still checks permissions.
tips.per_role: Changes are saved per role. Save every role you change.
tips.empty_group: A group without menus that is not clickable will not appear in the sidebar.
tips.reset: "Default layout" replaces that role's entire layout with the original one after you confirm.

platform_plans.purpose: This page is for managing the subscription plans offered on the sign-up page: price, usage limits, session rules, trial, and features for each institution type.

features.find: Search plans by code or name and filter by type: "All", "School", "Teacher", or "Session".
features.identity: Set the "Plan identity": code, name, badge, institution type, status, and description.
features.price: Set the pricing model, price, and tax. Per-session plans also offer "Volume discount" and "Allow session top-up".
features.limits: Set "Usage limits" and "Free trial", or "Session rules" for per-session plans.
features.features: Enable plan features and check the "Preview on the sign-up page".

steps.s1: Click "New plan", or select a plan in the left list to edit it.
steps.s2: Complete the "Plan identity" and "Price" sections.
steps.s3: Set the usage limits or session rules, trial, and "Features".
steps.s4: Check how the plan looks in "Preview on the sign-up page".
steps.s5: Click "Save" to save your changes, or "Publish" and confirm so the plan appears on the sign-up page. For active plans, use "Apply changes".

tips.existing: Price and feature changes apply to new subscriptions and the next renewal; issued invoices do not change.
tips.delete: Plans that already have customers cannot be deleted. Change the status to "Archived" if you no longer want to offer them.
